caption.ja: 固定入力のH₂ RHF：核間距離・s型基底系列・SCF公差を分けて比較。PySCFとの差、反復履歴と有限基底の残る制約を解説。
caption.en: Fixed-input H₂ RHF: separate geometry, s-basis sequence and SCF-tolerance comparisons. Reading states PySCF differences, histories and remaining finite-basis limits.

caption.ja: 固定Heセルの周期LDA：Γ点とkメッシュ、Gaussian軌道基底・FFT格子・SCFを分離。DFTK平面波参照の打切り収束と差も表示。
caption.en: Periodic LDA for fixed He: separate Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, FFT grid and SCF. Includes independently converged DFTK plane-wave reference differences.

caption.ja: 非対称He₂の解析力をエネルギー有限差分とDFTK参照で比較。力のk点・基底・FFT・SCF収束とBOMDの局所接続確認。
caption.en: Asymmetric-He₂ analytic forces versus energy finite differences and DFTK reference. Force k-point, basis, FFT and SCF refinement, plus a local BOMD interface check.

caption.ja: 固定した満階数・階数落ち行列で、Householder QR・片側Jacobi SVDの再構成、保持階数の直交性、LAPACKとの差を保存値から図示。丸めゼロは1e−16へ置いて表示。
caption.en: Saved reconstruction, retained-rank orthogonality and LAPACK differences for fixed full/rank-deficient Householder-QR and one-sided-Jacobi-SVD inputs. Roundoff zeros are displayed at 1e-16.

caption.ja: 再直交化Lanczos・ArnoldiのKrylov次元を変え、固有対残差と独立した密行列固有値との差を保存結果から比較。
caption.en: Stored eigenpair residuals and differences from independent dense eigenvalues as reorthogonalized Lanczos/Arnoldi Krylov dimensions increase.

caption.ja: Gauss–Legendreの次数と適応Simpsonの要求公差を走査した保存誤差。指数・Lorentz型積分の解析値を参照し、推定誤差を厳密上界とは扱わない。
caption.en: Saved Gauss–Legendre order and adaptive-Simpson tolerance sweeps against analytic exponential/Lorentzian integrals; estimated errors are not rigorous bounds.

caption.ja: 標準正規標的・固定seedの32連鎖。保存したCDF検査点、標本予算ごとの連鎖平均RMSE・平均観測量のESSを表示。全seedの保証ではない。
caption.en: Standard-normal target and 32 fixed-seed chains: stored CDF checkpoints, chain-mean RMSE and mean-observable ESS by sample budget. Not an every-seed guarantee.

caption.ja: 調和振動子BAOABの刻み0.4/0.2/0.1。離散定常共分散の偏り、有限標本誤差、正準CDF誤差とlag2の位置相関を保存値から分離表示。
caption.en: Stored harmonic-BAOAB steps 0.4/0.2/0.1 separate discrete stationary-covariance bias, sampling error, canonical-CDF errors and position correlation at lag 2.

caption.ja: 周期Fourierモードの線形反応拡散。16/32/64格子の連続解誤差と、固定格子での半離散厳密解に対する時間誤差を分けた保存収束図。
caption.en: Stored linear periodic Fourier reaction–diffusion refinement separates continuum errors on 16/32/64 grids from temporal errors against a fixed-grid semidiscrete exact solution.

caption.ja: a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1のSchnakenberg型。行列指数に対する線形誤差・成長率と、t=4の小振幅非線形初期パターンを保存値から表示。
caption.en: Schnakenberg-type a=0.1,b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1: stored linear errors/growth against a matrix exponential and a small nonlinear onset pattern at t=4.

caption.ja: 無次元の2変数FHN型ODEにt=10〜20の電流パルス。DOP853参照とRK4の興奮・回復、刻み0.1/0.05/0.025の収束と全出力点の差を保存結果から表示。
caption.en: A dimensionless two-variable FHN-type ODE with a t=10..20 current pulse: stored RK4/DOP853 excitation and recovery, steps 0.1/0.05/0.025 and all-output-time differences.

caption.ja: 中性立方セルの非対称8点電荷。Ewaldの実空間・逆空間打切りに対する力の差を保存値から表示。smooth PMEの格子・Bスプライン次数比較は同じ問題の補助例へ接続。
caption.en: Asymmetric eight-charge neutral cubic cell: saved force differences over Ewald real/reciprocal cutoffs. The same problem links to a smooth-PME mesh/B-spline-order supplement.

caption.ja: 固定seedの128粒子、2次元自由空間の対数核。FMMの展開次数2/4/8/12を独立した全対直接和と比べたポテンシャル・電場誤差の保存図。
caption.en: Stored potential/field errors for 128 fixed-seed particles with a 2D free-space log kernel: FMM orders 2/4/8/12 versus a separate all-pairs sum.

caption.ja: 1次元周期・振幅0.001の冷たい電子プラズマ。CIC静電PICの変位モードとcos(t)、別々の格子・時間刻み走査の保存誤差を表示。
caption.en: One-dimensional periodic cold electrons, amplitude 0.001: stored CIC electrostatic-PIC displacement versus cos(t), with separate grid and timestep error sweeps.

caption.ja: 等質なMaxwell分子の衝突成分。512/2048/8192粒子・16seedの保存モーメント誤差・標本不確かさと、物理時刻ではない衝突roundごとの異方性緩和。
caption.en: Homogeneous Maxwell-molecule collision component: stored moment errors/seed uncertainty for 512/2048/8192 particles over 16 seeds, and anisotropy per collision round, not physical time.

caption.ja: 光学的厚さ0.7の純吸収平板。32〜512セルのBeer–Lambert参照への空間誤差と、厳密セル内伝播を使う4〜32方向の角度誤差を分けた保存図。
caption.en: Pure-absorption slab of optical depth 0.7: stored 32–512-cell spatial errors versus Beer–Lambert and a separate 4–32-ordinate angular sweep using exact cell propagation.

caption.ja: 弱い四次ポテンシャルを持つ2自由度で、CSVRとLangevinの分布・温度とエネルギーの揺らぎ・相関を比較。正準分布を独立なBoltzmann求積から得ます。
caption.en: Compare CSVR and Langevin distributions, temperature/energy fluctuations and correlations for two weakly quartic modes. Independent Boltzmann quadrature provides equilibrium references.

caption.ja: 同じ2峰密度を、分散初期値の局所MH・同じ峰からの局所MH・対称reflectionを混ぜるMHで比較。期待した混合不良の検出と、実際の峰間移動を分けて検証します。
caption.en: Compare dispersed local MH, same-mode local MH and symmetry-informed reflection/local MH on the same bimodal target. Separate detecting expected mixing failures from successful finite-budget mode exploration.

caption.ja: 非零の磁気力と圧力勾配が釣り合う構成厳密解を使い、同じ初期セル状態・流束の速度上界・刻み列でCT/GLMを比較します。
caption.en: Use a constructed exact equilibrium with nonzero magnetic force balanced by a pressure gradient, matching CT/GLM initial cell states, flux speed bound and time-step sequence.

caption.ja: 実際の2次元Cartesian Euler計算の密度場。正方形全域128²セル、初期圧力ゼロ、γ=5/3、t=.6。白破線は厳密衝撃円。軸・対角方向の差と原点過熱を残し、1D半径例にも辿れます。
caption.en: Density from an actual2D Cartesian Euler computation:full square128²,p0=0,gamma5/3,t=.6. White dashed circle is the exact shock. Axis/diagonal differences and origin heating remain visible, with links to earlier1D radial examples.

caption.ja: 1次元球対称Eulerの保存済み半径密度を中心断面に表示。γ=5/3、E=ρ0=1、p0=0、t=.05、512球殻、有限投入半径.03。半解析的な点源参照との違いと衝撃層の誤差を残した図で、実2D Cartesian計算ではありません。
caption.en: A central-section view of saved one-dimensional spherical-radial Euler density:gamma5/3,E=rho0=1,p0=0,t=.05,512 shells and finite deposition radius.03. Point-source reference differences and shock errors remain visible; this is not an actual2D Cartesian computation.

caption.ja: 1次元球対称Eulerの保存済み半径密度を子午面に表示。γ=1.4、512球殻、r∈[0,.75]、R_s(−1)=.6、t=−.85。圧力ゼロの静止上流へ進む収束前の衝撃波を半解析参照と比較します。2D Cartesianや原点反射後の計算ではありません。
caption.en: A meridional-section display of saved one-dimensional spherical-radial Euler density: gamma=1.4, 512 shells, r in [0,0.75], Rs(-1)=0.6, t=-0.85. Compare the pre-collapse shock entering stationary zero-pressure upstream gas with a semi-analytic reference. This is not 2D Cartesian or post-collapse evolution.

caption.ja: 実際の2次元スカラー輸送の最細格子の保存セル平均。全[0,1]²のうちx∈[.28,.72], y∈[.53,.97]の円盤周辺を拡大し、一回転後の一次風上とminmod MUSCLを幾何学的な参照セル平均と比較します。切り欠きの数値拡散を残した図で、FCT法やEuler流体の計算ではありません。
caption.en: Saved cell means on the finest grid of actual two-dimensional scalar transport. Zoom x in[.28,.72],y in[.53,.97] from the full unit square and compare donor-cell upwinding and minmod MUSCL after one revolution against geometric reference cell means. Slot diffusion remains visible; this is not an FCT algorithm or Euler-flow calculation.

caption.ja: 保存した有限体積配列から描いた地形・水面と定常誤差のプレビュー。
caption.en: Preview of represented bed, saved FV surfaces and moving-steady errors.

caption.ja: 実際の1次元浅水計算の保存配列による水深・流量と乾湿前線のプレビュー。時空間図は1次元の5保存時刻です。
caption.en: Preview from actual saved 1D shallow-water depth/discharge arrays. The space-time panel shows five saved times, not a 2D flow.

caption.ja: 保存した最細Re100計算の流線と速さ。赤点は格子上の主渦、白抜き点はGhia表Vの主渦位置です。
caption.en: Saved finest Re100 streamlines and speed. Red dot: computed grid primary vortex; hollow dot: original Ghia TableV location.

reference_supplements.assumptions: Two-dimensional ideal-gas Euler flow with gamma=1.4 in [0,3]×[0,1] excluding the solid step x>=.6,y<.2. Uniform initial/inflow primitive state (rho,u,v,p)=(1.4,3,0,1), reflecting slip channel/step walls, right zero-gradient outflow and T=4. The reference is a separately written C++17 unsplit finite-volume implementation with primitive MUSCL generalized minmod(theta=1.5), Davis HLL flux and Heun/SSPRK2 at CFL=.3 on 240×80 and480×160 cells. Normal slopes touching walls/exterior boundaries are zero; reconstructed primitive slopes may be rescaled without altering cell means. The primary Python calculation uses piecewise-constant HLL plus Heun; flux family/time equations are shared, while implementation and spatial reconstruction are separate. No Woodward–Colella corner entropy/enthalpy reset, state floors or time-step retries are used. The uncorrected corner can produce an entropy layer that affects the downstream reflected shock/Mach stem. This is a finite-grid numerical reference, not an exact solution, rigorous error bound, replication of corner-corrected original PPM figures, or proof that fine slip lines/vortices are resolved.

reference_supplements.title: Wall manufactured solution: polynomial velocity and separate pressure operator
reference_supplements.assumptions: Unit square,viscosity.01,no-slip,psi*=8x²(1−x)²y²(1−y)²,u*=psi*_y,v*=−psi*_x,omega*=−Delta psi*. Construct s=u*omega*_x+v*omega*_y−nu*Delta omega* from the continuous vorticity PDE, qualified by independent tensor-coefficient differentiation. PDE wall vorticity uses the same Thom closure as the cavity without exact injection. Nonzero-Dirichlet Poisson/gradient for p_op=x²+y²+sin(pi*x)sin(pi*y) is a separate operator problem, not coupled flow or cavity pressure.
reference_supplements.formula: psi*=8 f(x)f(y),f(z)=z²(1−z)²; s=u*omega*_x+v*omega*_y−nu*Delta omega*. Separate: p_op=x²+y²+sin(pi*x)sin(pi*y).
reference_supplements.reference_scope: Manufactured fields with independent analytic differentiation, not an independent flow engine. Pressure is eliminated from streamfunction evolution, so no pressure gauge applies there; pressure-operator verification remains separate.

reference_supplements.title: 2D level-set circle translation: interface, area and redistancing: analytic signed-distance reference
reference_supplements.assumptions: All quantities are nondimensional on[0,1]², with phi<0 inside. The prescribed divergence-free rigid motion keeps the circle away from the boundary. Two exterior ghost layers receive analytic data at each RK stage; this is not a periodic boundary. Every interior value is numerically advanced. Observe0/.25/.5/.75/1; max(|u|+|v|)dt/dx<=.35.
reference_supplements.reference_scope: Analytic center motion and signed distance provide the reference. Take worst errors over the four positive common observation times. Interface error samples linearly interpolated grid-edge zeros; area comes from the negative portion of a piecewise-linear triangulation between grid centers, retaining initial geometric bias. Also record phi error and distance-gradient quality in|phi_exact|<=2dx, each redistancing area jump and a separateN64 CFL-halving sensitivity. Geometry is analytic and sampled; no independent numerical PDE engine is executed.
